pokedexEntries.bk: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

pokedexEntries.wh: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

pokedexEntries.x: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

pokedexEntries.or: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

pokedexEntries.y: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

pokedexEntries.as: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

pokedexEntries.sw: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.

pokedexEntries.sh: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.
